limb strength (MRC) examination: not reliably testable because of impaired consciousness and myoclonus

serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
serum calcium, magnesium and phosphate: normal

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy with post-anoxic myoclonus, caused by a perioperative cardiopulmonary arrest

ALTERNATIVE: Nonconvulsive status epilepticus

ALTERNATIVE: Toxic-metabolic encephalopathy

ALTERNATIVE: Acute structural brain injury unrelated to hypoxia, such as ischemic stroke or intracranial hemorrhage
